name: Be a Snake
desc:
Be a Snake is an all new snake simulator and tycoon!

- Eat small animals to become bigger
- Eat other snakes to become bigger
- Eat other players to earn Skulls
- Earn and collect rare snake skins
- Trade snake skins with others

Premium benefits: Premium players get +100 starting Skulls

Weekly updates! Make sure you follow the game for notifications

LIKE and FAV for a special skin!
